article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Indica-dominant hybrid
Genetics: Super Skunk × White Widow
Breeder: Nirvana Seeds
THC Content: 13–19%
CBD Content: Low, generally below 1%
Terpene Profile: Pinene , myrcene , humulene
Primary Flavors: Sweet Skunk, earth, pine, herbs, spice
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–10 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: October
Indoor Yield: 450–550 g/m²
Outdoor Yield: Moderate to high
Grow Difficulty: Easy

Wonder Woman was developed around a practical idea: combine two proven Dutch cannabis families and select for plants that produce large amounts of dense, resinous flower without demanding expert-level cultivation. Nirvana Seeds crossed Super Skunk with its White Widow line to create an indica-dominant marijuana cultivar distinguished by oversized colas, strong trichome production, relatively compact growth, and the sweet-pungent aroma associated with classic Skunk genetics.

Nirvana currently lists THC at approximately 13–19%, describes the variety as easy to grow, and specifically positions it for beginners, larger-scale cultivators, and hash makers because of its combination of yield and resin. Unlike many modern weed hybrids built around dessert flavors, Wonder Woman has a distinctly traditional sensory identity: sweet earth and Skunk are supported by pine, herbs, and spice, while the effects combine an initially focused mental state with increasingly noticeable physical relaxation. Its appeal is straightforward but enduring—dependable production, recognizable genetics, and a balanced experience in a plant that does not require an elaborate cultivation strategy.
Genetics and Lineage

The breeder-confirmed genetics of Wonder Woman are Super Skunk × White Widow. Nirvana Seeds currently lists that exact parentage and classifies the completed cultivar as indica dominant. Both sides of the cross are important pieces of European cannabis breeding history. Super Skunk was developed to reinforce the vigorous growth, pungent aroma, and heavy flower formation associated with the Skunk family, while White Widow became famous for dense trichome coverage and potent hybrid effects. Pairing the two produced a plant that carries the obvious structural advantages of both: strong branching, substantial resin formation, relatively fast flowering, and thick flowers that can be produced efficiently in an indoor garden.

The lineage also explains why Wonder Woman can feel more balanced than its indica classification might imply. Super Skunk contributes a cheerful, socially comfortable quality alongside its physical relaxation, while White Widow has long been associated with a stronger cerebral component. The result can begin with mental engagement before settling gradually into a heavier state. Structurally, the hybrid usually remains shorter and bushier than a sativa-dominant plant but may stretch noticeably once flowering begins. Nirvana describes it as a compact, relatively short plant with dense, resinous flowers, making the genetics particularly well suited to gardens where vertical space is limited.
Effects and Experience

Wonder Woman tends to build rather than strike all at once. The early portion of the experience can feel clear, focused, and pleasantly upbeat, especially when consumed in moderate amounts. Conversation may flow more easily, familiar activities feel more interesting, and there can be enough mental energy for movies, music, gaming, or simple creative tasks. Nirvana categorizes the effects as focusing and sedating, an unusual combination that captures the strain’s progression better than describing it as simply relaxing.

Physical heaviness becomes more obvious later. Muscular tension may begin to fade, the pace of activity slows, and the initial mental clarity can develop into a warmer and less demanding state. Larger amounts are more likely to produce substantial lethargy or drowsiness, especially in consumers with limited THC tolerance. With breeder-listed THC ranging from 13% to 19%, the cultivar sits below many of today’s extreme-potency cannabis strains while still being strong enough to create significant intoxication. That moderate-to-strong range may also make it more approachable for experienced consumers who prefer a full effect without deliberately seeking THC percentages above 25%.
Medical Benefits

Wonder Woman’s progression from mental focus toward deeper relaxation may appeal to medical cannabis consumers who prefer a cultivar that remains relatively functional early in the experience. Some people choose marijuana with this type of profile when they want temporary relief from stress, physical tension, or difficulty winding down while avoiding immediate couch-lock. The later sedating component may also make the strain more appropriate for evening use than for the beginning of a demanding workday.

No controlled clinical trials establish Wonder Woman itself as a treatment for insomnia, anxiety, chronic pain, depression, or another medical condition. Strain names also do not guarantee identical chemistry between harvests. Even within Nirvana’s stated 13–19% THC range, different phenotypes and growing environments can produce noticeably different experiences. Medical consumers should therefore rely on the cannabinoid analysis of the particular flower they are using and appropriate healthcare guidance rather than treating a cannabis strain description as a medical prescription.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Sweetness appears first, but the character is unmistakably Skunk rather than candy. Nirvana describes the taste as pungent, earthy, and sweet, which closely matches the old-school parentage. Freshly opened flowers can produce a mixture of sweet herbs, moist earth, pine needles, and musky cannabis pungency. Breaking the buds apart generally strengthens the sharper Skunk and herbal components, revealing a profile that is much more resinous and botanical than fruity.

The breeder identifies pinene, myrcene, and humulene as the dominant terpenes associated with Wonder Woman. Pinene helps explain the dry pine and woody qualities, while myrcene corresponds with herbal and earthy depth. Humulene contributes additional spice and woody bitterness that can become especially noticeable on the exhale. Together they create a flavor profile that feels distinctly different from today’s terpene-heavy candy cultivars. Smoke or vapor can begin slightly sweet before moving toward pine, herbs, earth, and lingering Skunk.
Growing Information

Yield is arguably Wonder Woman’s most famous cultivation trait. Nirvana promotes the strain specifically for its heavy production, listing indoor yields of approximately 450–550 grams per square meter. The flowers develop into hard, thick colas rather than loose sativa-style formations, and their relatively straightforward structure makes mature plants easier to trim than varieties carrying excessive leaf within the buds. Heavy trichome production adds considerable visual appeal and also explains why Nirvana recommends the genetics to growers interested in making hash.

The plant is forgiving enough for beginners. Nirvana rates Wonder Woman as easy to grow and notes that it performs successfully both indoors and outdoors while displaying particularly good resistance to pathogens and disease. Indoor plants usually remain manageable in height but can approximately double in size during the transition from vegetative growth into flowering, so growers should allow enough vertical room before switching the lighting cycle. Sea of Green cultivation works especially well because the strain can produce long, dense colas efficiently across an even canopy. Historical breeder-derived specifications place flowering at roughly eight to ten weeks.

Outdoor plants benefit from direct sunlight, sufficient root space, and a reasonably dry finish to the season. Harvest generally arrives during October in the Northern Hemisphere. Although its disease resistance provides some insurance against imperfect conditions, dense flowers should still be inspected carefully during humid weather. Good branch spacing and airflow become increasingly important as the heavy colas swell. The combination of short-to-medium height, high yield, resin abundance, and moderate cultivation demands helps explain why Wonder Woman has remained part of Nirvana’s catalog for so long.
FAQ
What are the genetics of Wonder Woman?
Wonder Woman is a cross of Super Skunk and White Widow created by Nirvana Seeds. The breeder currently lists this exact lineage on its official strain page.
Is Wonder Woman indica or sativa?

Nirvana Seeds classifies Wonder Woman as an indica-dominant hybrid. Its compact plant structure, dense buds, and progressively sedating physical effects demonstrate the indica influence, although the early high can remain mentally focused and relatively upbeat.
How much THC does Wonder Woman have?

Nirvana currently lists THC at approximately 13–19%, with 19% representing the upper end of the breeder’s stated range. Actual potency can differ depending on phenotype, growing environment, harvest timing, and laboratory methodology.
What does Wonder Woman taste like?

The cultivar has a classic sweet Skunk profile with earthy, pine, herbal, and spicy characteristics. Nirvana specifically lists pungent, earthy, and sweet flavors and identifies pinene, myrcene, and humulene among its dominant terpenes.
How long does Wonder Woman take to flower?
Indoor plants generally require approximately eight to ten weeks of flowering. Under a well-managed Sea of Green setup, yields can reach roughly 450–550 grams per square meter.
Final Thoughts on Wonder Woman

Wonder Woman reflects an earlier style of cannabis breeding in which high production, resin, manageable plant structure, and dependable effects were treated as equally important. Super Skunk gives the cultivar its pungent sweetness and vigorous flower development, while White Widow reinforces trichome coverage and hybrid potency. Together they create weed that remains recognizable without relying on exaggerated fruit, candy, or dessert flavors.

For growers, the strongest argument is efficiency. Wonder Woman is easy to cultivate, relatively compact, resistant to common plant problems, capable of producing approximately 450–550 g/m² indoors, and ready after roughly eight to ten weeks of flowering. For consumers, the combination of sweet Skunk, pine, earth, and herbs accompanies an effect that begins focused before becoming progressively more relaxing.

In a modern market crowded with complicated multi-generation crosses, Wonder Woman remains refreshingly straightforward. It is Super Skunk crossed with White Widow, bred by Nirvana Seeds for heavy resin and high production, and still available from the breeder decades into Nirvana’s history. That combination of documented lineage, accessible cultivation, and classic cannabis character makes Wonder Woman a useful reference point for anyone exploring the enduring influence of Dutch marijuana breeding.
